title: Ran and the Gray World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ran Uruma, a young girl from a family of sorcerers, cannot wait to grow up and become a sorceress like her mother; with a pair of magical sneakers she transforms into an adult and sets off on her own. Her father and older brother Jin try to keep her safe, but Ran wants adventures, and in her adult form she meets a rich playboy, Otaro Mikado, without understanding the perils of the grown-up world.
life_message: Growing up cannot be rushed; family love and time shape who a child becomes.
